# 2 Clement — Chapter 17 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 17
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Let us therefore repent with our whole heart, lest any of us perish by the way. For if we have received commandments that we should also do this — to tear men away from idols and to instruct them — how much more must we not allow a soul that already knows God to perish?
2. Let us then help one another and bring back those who have gone astray, so that we may save all and admonish and convert one another.
3. And let us not only appear to believe and pay attention now, while we are being admonished by the elders; but also when we go home, let us remember the Lord's commandments and not let worldly desires drag us back; but let us come here more often and strive to make progress in the Lord's commandments.
4. So that all of us, being of one mind, may be gathered together for life. For the Lord said: "I come to gather all nations, tribes, and tongues." He speaks here of the day of his appearing when he shall come and redeem each one according to their works.
5. And the unbelievers will see his glory and power, and they will be astounded when they see the kingdom of the world given to Jesus, saying: "Woe to us, because it was you, and we did not know it, and we did not believe, and we were not obedient to the elders when they proclaimed to us our salvation." And their worm shall not die and their fire shall not be quenched, and they shall be a spectacle to all flesh.
6. It is for the day of judgment, the day on which those who have deviated from the commandments of God and perverted the teaching of Jesus will see great power and be condemned.
7. But the righteous, who have done good and endured torments and hated the amusements of the soul, when they see those who went astray and denied Jesus in word or deed being punished with terrible torments in unquenchable fire, will give glory to God, saying: "There shall be hope for the one who has served God with his whole heart."
